scripts.build-engine: cd engine; mkdir dist/; gulp; cp -a dist/. ../public/corelibs/wick-engine/
scripts.build-engine-windows: cd engine & mkdir dist  2>nul &    gulp & xcopy /EY dist\. ..\public\corelibs\wick-engine\
scripts.prerelease-deploy: npm run build; cp -r build/* ../wick-editor-prerelease/; cd ../wick-editor-prerelease; rm CNAME; echo 'test.candlestickers.app/' > CNAME; git add .; git commit -m 'update prerelease build'; git push --force;
scripts.check-branch: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const b=(process.env.GITHUB_HEAD_REF||process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME||execSync('git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD')).toString().trim(); if(b!=='development'){console.error('✖ Deploy test only from development (current: '+b+')'); process.exit(1);} console.log('✔ Branch ok:', b);"
scripts.check-branch-prod: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const b=(process.env.GITHUB_HEAD_REF||process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME||execSync('git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD')).toString().trim(); if(!['main','master'].includes(b)){console.error('✖ Deploy to prod only from main/master (current: '+b+')'); process.exit(1);} console.log('✔ Branch ok:', b);"
scripts.master-deploy: npm run check-branch-prod; gh-pages -d build -b gh-pages -m "deploy prod"
scripts.test-deploy: npm run check-branch; PUBLIC_URL=/test/ npm run build:nocname && gh-pages -d build -b gh-pages --dest test -m "deploy test"
scripts.phonegap-deploy: npm run build; cd ../wick-editor-phonegap; npm run prepare-dir; cd ../wick-editor; cp -r build/* ../wick-editor-phonegap/www; cd ../wick-editor-phonegap; npm run prepare-app; git add .; git commit -m 'update phonegap build'; git push --force;
scripts.phonegap-predeploy: npm run build; cd ../wick-editor-phonegap; npm run prepare-dir; cd ../wick-editor; cp -r build/* ../wick-editor-phonegap/www; cd ../wick-editor-phonegap; npm run prepare-app;
